body:
Source: repository maintenance audit (orchestration area, follow-up to PR #1071). 28 mutation seams across 21 lib files in packages/autopilot/lib/ are not named in test/ac-registry.mjs or invoked by any test in the repository. They represent un-exercised fault injection switches that can be safely excised.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Across the 21 lib files (ci, deps, diffcheck, digest, gates, github, init, maintain, preflight-a, preflight-b, push, records, recover, reset, retire, revalidate, review, round, status, token-refresh, triage), remove the 28 dead seam registrations and simplify each consult site to its legitimate non-mutated path.
2. In packages/autopilot/lib/mutations.mjs, remove 'records.skipRedaction' from FOUNDATION_SEAMS.
3. Where all seams in a file were removed and active/registerSeams are no longer needed, remove the unused import.
4. Do NOT edit test/ac-registry.mjs, test/spec-coverage.test.mjs, or docs/specs/issue-autopilot-local.md.
5. Keep all existing tests green.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 All 28 dead seams removed. verify: `git grep -E -n '(ci\.redWaitsForPending|deps\.ignoreNpmrc|diffcheck\.ignoreSymlinks|digest\.postWithoutIntent|gates\.ignoreOrder|gates\.reuseClone|github\.ignoreTruncation|init\.writeOutsideRepo|maintain\.skipPreconditions|maintain\.maintainAnyState|preflight\.ignoreMissingLabels|preflight\.ignoreExclude|preflight\.anyModelFamily|preflight\.rmAnyPath|push\.skipPostPushVerify|push\.skipRemoteUrlCheck|records\.skipRedaction|recover\.forgetPushedWithoutPr|reset\.allowRecordlessRemoteDelete|retire\.forceRemove|revalidate\.ignoreUpdatedAt|revalidate\.ignoreOpenPr|review\.allowSummaryReview|run\.skipDiffCheckBeforePush|status\.skipQuotaAppend|tokenRefresh\.keepKey|tokenRefresh\.skipRecheck|triage\.noStdoutCap)' packages/autopilot/lib` prints nothing.
- AC2 Autopilot package test suite green. verify: `npm test -w packages/autopilot` exits 0.
- AC3 Full AC gate passes green. verify: `npm run test:gate -w packages/autopilot` exits 0.
- AC4 Mutation gate green. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0.
title: refactor(autopilot): remove 28 dead mutation seams unreferenced by any test
